text: Which statement correctly matches each theory of consciousness with what it primarily explains?
choices: Both Global Workspace Theory and IIT are versions of higher-order thought theory
Global Workspace Theory identifies consciousness with Φ, and IIT with global broadcasting
Global Workspace Theory (Baars/Dehaene) explains access via global broadcasting, while Integrated Information Theory (Tononi) identifies consciousness with integrated information Φ
Higher-order theories deny that access and phenomenality can be distinguished
explanation: GWT holds that information becomes conscious when broadcast in a global workspace accessible to many subsystems — an account aimed at access — whereas IIT identifies consciousness with a system's integrated information (Φ). Option 1 swaps the two theories; options 0 and 3 misdescribe the higher-order framework. Each theory targets a different explanandum.
